name: Seafile (Legacy)
tagline: Seafile is an open source file sync and share platform, focusing on reliability and performance.
description: Seafile is an open source file sync and share platform, focusing on reliability and performance. Seafile's built-in collaborative document SeaDoc, make it easy for collaborative writing and publishing documents.

questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-seafile application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-seafile
  # The `big-bear-seafile` service definition
  big-bear-seafile:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-seafile
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: seafileltd/seafile-mc:11.0.13@sha256:1239b087aa4bdf1b60a3802e80855f230736ac5d5fa3325a40b15d4c598f422c
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Service dependencies
    depends_on:
      big-bear-seafile-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      big-bear-seafile-memcached:
        condition: service_started
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/shared:/shared
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8080 of the host to port 80 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
      # - "443:443"  # If https is enabled, cancel the comment.
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=big-bear-seafile-db # Specifies MySQL service host name.
      - DB_ROOT_PASSWD=${SECRET_DB_ROOT_PASSWD} # Requested, the value should be root's password of MySQL service.
      - TIME_ZONE=Etc/UTC # Optional, default is UTC. Should be uncomment and set to your local time zone.
      - SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com # Specifies Seafile admin user, default is 'me@example.com'.
      - SEAFILE_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${SECRET_SEAFILE_ADMIN_PASSWORD} # Specifies Seafile admin password, default is 'asecret'.
      - SEAFILE_SERVER_LETSENCRYPT=false # Whether to use https or not.
      - SEAFILE_SERVER_HOSTNAME=docs.seafile.com # Specifies your host name if https is enabled.
    # Networks to be attached to the container
    networks:
      - big_bear_seafile_network
  # Database service for seafile
  big-bear-seafile-db:
    image: mariadb:10.11@sha256:be981e4113326ada8d6004174dd09eeaefc03094037f811182a52d4f2e737350
    container_name: big-bear-seafile-db
    environment:
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET_DB_ROOT_PASSWD} # Requested, set the root's password of MySQL service.
      - MYSQL_LOG_CONSOLE=true
      - MARIADB_AUTO_UPGRADE=1
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "healthcheck.sh", "--connect", "--innodb_initialized"]
      start_period: 1m
      start_interval: 10s
      interval: 1m
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    networks:
      - big_bear_seafile_network
  # Memcached service for seafile
  big-bear-seafile-memcached:
    container_name: big-bear-seafile-memcached
    image: memcached:1.6.39@sha256:462fa779babc9b64a235a69dd843cb79fb3591f229ee1f3ff6cb2ca058d8a759
    entrypoint: memcached -m 256
    networks:
      - big_bear_seafile_network
# Networks used by the application
networks:
  big_bear_seafile_network:
    driver: bridge
